$comment: AEO probe question bank. The first 23 questions are the original starter bank (commit f620188) minus cheap-eats-hialeah. Keep their ids and text unchanged: the 2026-10-01 baseline is keyed on them, so compare them separately from the rest. The rest were added 2026-10-01. The new questions were written by hand. Topics and local terms (ventanita, fritanga, pan con lechón, viandas) were checked against Miami press coverage found by web search (Miami New Times, The Infatuation, Telemundo 51, Diario las Américas). No People Also Ask, Reddit or Search Console data was captured yet; add real queries from those when available. Entity questions use only the business name and city from data-import/listings.json, never other listing detail. Spanish is written the way Miami speakers say it, not translated word for word; ES ids end in -es. Intent rule for new questions: hours, open or not, reservations and similar → fact; what is it, what is it like, what is it known for → entity; history → fact. intent: best-of | near-me | fact | events | entity. No price questions (cheap eats, happy hour, free things to do): the site makes no price claims, so it can't be the answer to them. Civic block (added 2026-10-07, AEO round 3): 28 Spanish questions with English twins, ids prefixed civic- (ES ids end in -es), intent civic. They ask about living in Miami-Dade (trash, recycling and bulk days, flood and storm-surge zones, who represents you, where you vote, school zones, the free buses, homestead). Phrased the way people ask (tarecos, guagua), not translated word for word. Report them separately from the original 23 and from the rest: run them alone with pnpm aeo:probe --intent civic. intent civic is used only by this block; the older civic-groups-hialeah (best-of) is not part of it.
